Nvidia's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang's link to a suspected Chinese spy.

• Nvidia's board says it is starting an independent investigation into its CEO.
• A memo seen by US officials claims a tech executive was recruited by China's spy agency to spy on him.
• Huang told staff he had an affair with that executive and apologised to the company.

Your take: Should tech bosses get security checks like officials? Tell us in the comments.
